title: The Mandate
description: One year. Fifty-two weeks. Every choice you have made — as Chancellor, as wife, as mother, as daughter — has led here. The epilogue is yours.

title: Budget Allocation — Closing the Books
description: The final budget review. Every allocation, every cut, every emergency fund drawn down — the ledgers tell the story of your year in office more truthfully than any speech. The treasury needs your signature one last time.

title: Family — The Last Breakfast
description: Fifty-two weeks ago, you woke up as Chancellor and your family woke up without you. Today, the residence kitchen table has places set. However many of them are filled — the table itself is still there. So are you.

title: The Kitchen
description: A house in Kravenstal you have not stood in for thirty years. Jonas holds the Assembly's closing letter. The window light falls the way you remember it falling.
